messages:
omar: Hey infra team — onboarding tenant 'bridge' into ap-northeast-11. Need quota lifts for p4d, p5, and g5 instances across 3 AZs, plus ENI and SNAT headroom. Can someone confirm the exact limits we should request and whether warm-pool reservation is needed?

sarah: @omar can you paste the account ID and intended AZ spread? also are these for Dedicated or Hosted capacity?

omar: Account: 998877665544, plan is Dedicated (reserved pool) for initial pilot 4 nodes, likely scale to 12. AZs: ap-northeast-1a/1b/1c equivalent in ap-northeast-11 (we mapped to 3 AZ equivalent).

kyle: For Dedicated we should request ceilings for p5 and g5 first, p4d if we expect ML training jobs. Warm pool = yes for predictable latency; costs ~0.7x of on-demand for reserved warm slices.

anna: SNAT: confirm we have enough public IPs/NATGW bandwidth. Some regions have low SNAT ephemeral capacity; request bump on "Nat Gateway" and private ENI limit. Also check EIP quota.

infra-bot: quota-ticket created: Q-10982 with AWS support. Initial message: "Request increase: p5, g5, p4d instance quota + elastic network interfaces + EIP pool + NAT gateway throughput for account 998877665544 in ap-northeast-11". ETA: 48-72h.

omar: thanks. Sarah — subnet sizing: we need room for ENIs per GPU instance: p5/g5 require 2 ENIs per host for our placement group; estimate 50 ENIs initially. Can you confirm VPC CIDR?

sarah: VPC CIDR is 10.44.0.0/16. Current subnets are /20. We can carve /22 slices per AZ to have more IPs; ops prefers not changing existing routing. Might need new subnet per AZ.

kyle: cost note: If we reserve warm-pool (4 nodes p5) we should compare committed discount vs on-demand GPU spot pools. For production SLOs we prefer reserved warm pool + autoscale. I'll write rough calc in a sec.

jen: quick ask — does the quota ticket include capacity to create placement groups and accelerated networking ENA? AWS sometimes denies without that info. Add: "Support accelerated networking (ENA) + placement group capacity"

omar: added to ticket comment. Also tagging networking: @anna please check with cloud-networking to pre-provision NATGW route tables and ensure egress ACLs.

anna: will do. FYI our last NATGW bump in ap-southeast had 2-hour maintenance; plan for small outage if they need re-IP. I'll flag request as high priority.

infra-bot: Q-10982 updated: AWS replied requesting justification for expected sustained vCPU and ENI usage. Suggested adding sample autoscale curve and projected RPS.

omar: dropping basic autoscale numbers: baseline 4 GPUs (p5) 24/7 for 2 weeks, scale to 12 GPUs during business hours (8am-8pm JST) — average token throughput 4M tokens/day. ENI peak 50, baseline 16. Put that in the ticket now.

kyle: also list fallback plan: allow routing to eu-west-2 dedicated pool if capacity constrained. That helps AWS approve cross-region flexibility.

jen: added ENA/placement group line and fallback region note.

infra-bot: AWS support: "Provisionally approved for g5 and ENI increases; p5/p4d requires capacity validation — provisioning team will follow up." Ticket ETA updated to 36h for partial approval.

omar: great. keep thread here for followups. If AWS asks for a contact, use me (omar@redwood.ai). :thumbsup:

sarah: once quotas land I'll schedule warm-pool bootstrap runbook. leaving checklist: 1) subnets (/22) per AZ 2) NATGW IPs 3) placement-group policy 4) AMI bake with ENA drivers 5) warm-pool create script.

kyle: I'll prepare cost comparison doc and a tiny smoke test script to validate KV cache and latency on p5.

omar: thanks all — will update when AWS confirms full approval.
